quote: The Initial Term ends December 31, 2026. Counting back 120 days from December 31, 2026 yields approximately **September 2, 2026**. The SPA is dated **September 21, 2026**—naming three weeks after the deadline. The option has lapsed.
reason: Issue 2 of the memo identifies the right document and provision: Supply Agreement Section 3.2 and its 120-day notice requirement. It states the September 2, 2026 deadline correctly and notes that the deadline passed before the SPA was signed on September 21, 2026. It concludes that the option and the Extension Pricing have been lost, and it explains why this matters to the client: supply ends right after Closing, there is no price protection, and the purchase price should be adjusted or the contract renegotiated before Closing.
